events.fact: Shopify custom OAuth credentials can be created via the Shopify Partners / Dev Dashboard.
GraphQL Admin API rate limits start at 100 points/second for Standard stores, up to 1,000 points/second for Shopify Plus.
REST Admin API rate limits start at 2 requests/second for Standard stores up to 20 requests/second for Shopify Plus.

probe.summary: No public OAuth/OIDC discovery document; endpoints must come from the provider docs.

events.fact: Shopify supports both online access tokens (tied to an active staff session, expiring) and offline access tokens (persistent, do not expire until uninstalled or revoked).
Shopify app distribution methods include public apps (for the Shopify App Store or custom install URLs) and custom apps (built directly for a single merchant store without review).

events.title: Authenticate a standalone or API-only app

events.fact: Shopify API rate limits use a leaky bucket algorithm where requests restore over time based on the store's tier.
Community reports indicate official app review times are stated as 5-10 business days, but can extend significantly in practice.

events.title: How long does it take for an app review to be completed?

events.fact: Shopify access tokens can be requested as online tokens or offline tokens via the authorization code grant flow.
